data.title: The package at the start gets left behind
story: Warehouse report: the robot sometimes reaches the flag empty-handed. Strangely, the program works fine on the middle map.
Compare the maps that pass and the ones that fail. Which package does the robot never pick up?

explanation: The old program moves first and checks for a package afterwards, so the package on the starting tile is never checked. Check has_package() before forward() so every tile is checked, including the first one.
hints: Run it and look at the failing map: where is the package that got left behind?
The order inside the while decides which tiles get checked. Is the first tile checked?
Swap the order: if has_package(): pick_up() first, then forward().
